title: Stage 17: Preselected Faithfulness Judgment Audit Sample
selection_method: Sort the 140 non-pilot question IDs by SHA256 of 'faithfulness-audit-v1:' + question_id; select the first 8. Selection uses IDs only, before per-question v4 judgments are inspected.
pilot_exclusion: The first five ordered run-manifest IDs were used to debug the judge and are excluded from this audit sample.
